title: Japanese Pork Skewers with Umami Glaze
description: Delicious Japanese-inspired pork skewers with a rich umami glaze, perfect for a quick and easy dinner. This recipe combines the flavors of Japan with the convenience of a simple marinade.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together Japanese rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, umami seasoning, and sugar.
2. Add the pork cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
3. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated pork onto the bamboo skewers.
4. Grill the pork skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F.
5. While the pork is cooking, prepare the glaze by whisking together 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of water in a small bowl.
6. Brush the glaze onto the pork skewers during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
7. Remove the pork skewers from the grill and garnish with chopped green onions.
8. Serve the pork skewers hot with additional glaze on the side, if desired.
